about.description:
cppbmad provides a modern C++ interface to the Fortran Bmad library using
proxy classes for direct memory access. It supports tracking and other simulations
coordination with wrapped procedures. pybmad uses nanobind to
wrap the C++ layer, exposing the Bmad and Tao ecosystems to Python.
about.summary: cppbmad and pybmad are wrappers for Bmad, a relativistic charged-particle dynamics simulations in accelerators and storage rings.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

# Versioning notes:
# bmad:    YYYYMMDD-M      (build M for the day)
# cppbmad: YYYYMMDD-M[.N]  (bindings bugfix patch N)

context:
  version: "20260828-0"
  safe_version: ${{ version | replace("-", ".") }}
  bmad_version: ${{ version | split(".") | first | replace("-", ".") }}
  build: 0

recipe:
  name: cppbmad-pybmad
  version: ${{ safe_version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/ken-lauer/cppbmad/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a0795429cfa028990085c0a3df5dcf5fd100de2390823c5e8d8a5f0a658aac00

build:
  number: ${{ build }}
  skip:
    - win

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: cppbmad-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - make
        # nanobind.stubgen requires typing_extensions for py310
        - typing_extensions
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - nanobind >=2.0,<3.0
      host:
        - bmad ${{ bmad_version }}.* nompi_*
        - python
        - nanobind >=2.0,<3.0
  - package:
      name: cppbmad
    inherit: cppbmad-build
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('cppbmad', upper_bound="x.x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          # cppbmad is independent of Python
          - python
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - make
      host:
        - bmad ${{ bmad_version }}.* nompi_*
      run:
        - bmad ${{ bmad_version }}.*
        - if: osx
          then:
            - libgcc
    build:
      files:
        - include/bmad.hpp
        - include/bmad/*.hpp
        - include/bmad/*.h
        - include/bmad/generated/*.hpp
        - lib/libcppbmad*
        - lib/cmake/cppbmad
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libcppbmad${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/bmad.hpp

  - package:
      name: pybmad
    inherit: cppbmad-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - make
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - nanobind
      host:
        - bmad ${{ bmad_version }}.* nompi_*
        - python
        - nanobind
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('cppbmad', upper_bound="x.x") }}
      run:
        - python
        - bmad ${{ bmad_version }}.*
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('cppbmad', upper_bound="x.x") }}
        - if: osx
          then:
            - libgcc
    build:
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/pybmad/**
    tests:
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - pybmad

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ken-lauer/cppbmad
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: cppbmad and pybmad are wrappers for Bmad, a relativistic charged-particle dynamics simulations in accelerators and storage rings.
  description: |
    cppbmad provides a modern C++ interface to the Fortran Bmad library using
    proxy classes for direct memory access. It supports tracking and other simulations
    coordination with wrapped procedures. pybmad uses nanobind to
    wrap the C++ layer, exposing the Bmad and Tao ecosystems to Python.
  documentation: https://github.com/ken-lauer/cppbmad/wiki

extra:
  feedstock-name: cppbmad
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ken-lauer
